questions.question: Which king "did more evil than all before him" and married Jezebel?
What happened to Zimri after he seized the throne for seven days?
options: He was crowned king over all Israel
He reigned in peace for many years
He burned the palace over himself and died
He fled away into the wilderness and escaped
questions.answer: He burned the palace over himself and died

questions.question: Ahab set up an altar for Baal in Samaria.
_____ did more evil in God's sight than all the kings before him.
Ahab married _____, who promoted the worship of Baal.
